prompt_text:
Generate ONE full-body view of the exact character in reference Image 1, which is the authoritative costume model sheet. Image 2 is this character at another view and only supports consistent identity/style. Required camera view: EXACTLY halfway between direct front and strict left profile: a strong 45-degree FRONT THREE-QUARTER view, face looking diagonally SCREEN LEFT, both eyes visible but far eye compressed. Chest and entire skirt rotate 45 degrees too.
Rigid neutral standing turntable: whole head, body, feet share this angle, no head looking back separately. Maintain slim original body and dress design. Asymmetric black cape on anatomical LEFT, white puff sleeve on anatomical RIGHT, flower vine/ruffles on anatomical RIGHT. Do not mirror. Full character centered with clear margins on genuinely transparent RGBA background, no text. Fine anime linework, clean restrained cel shading. Portrait 1024x1536. Keep same vertical scale as Image 2 but rotate character, not camera pitch. DO NOT COPY the image 2 viewing angle.
